title: ETH-TraceBench: A Large-Scale Event-Stream Benchmark for Ethereum DeFi under Temporal, Protocol, and Contract Shift
abstract: arXiv:2609.23659v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ethereum decentralized finance (DeFi) provides a public, time-stamped record of transaction-level event streams, but the same public symbols can create strong machine-learning shortcuts. We introduce ETH-TraceBench, a benchmark for evaluating Ethereum DeFi representations under temporal, protocol, pool/infrastructure, and symbolic shift. The raw event universe covers January 2021-December 2025 and contains 1.35 billion transactions with logs and 5.01 billion raw log rows. Model evaluation uses a fixed 911,267-instance supervised sample, training on 2021-2024, selecting models on 2025H1, and testing on 2025H2. Simple models perform strongly on the aggregate temporal test: TraceStats-GB reaches 0.953 macro-F1 and TopicEmitterHashMLP 0.959 on the canonical DEX test set. translated_title: ETH-TraceBench：面向以太坊DeFi在时间、协议与合约偏移下的大规模事件流基准
translated_abstract: 以太坊去中心化金融（DeFi）提供了公开的、带时间戳的交易级事件流记录，但这些公开符号同样可能造成强烈的机器学习捷径（shortcut）。我们提出ETH-TraceBench，一个用于评估以太坊DeFi表示在时间、协议、资金池/基础设施以及符号偏移下表现的基准。原始事件全集覆盖2021年1月至2025年12月，包含13.5亿笔带日志的交易和50.1亿条原始日志行。模型评估使用固定的911,267个实例的有监督样本，在2021-2024年数据上训练，在2025年上半年进行模型选择，在2025年下半年进行测试。简单模型在聚合时间测试上表现强劲：TraceStats-GB在标准DEX测试集上达到0.953的宏平均F1，TopicEmitterHashMLP达到0.959。而在协议新颖性场景下性能急剧下降，TraceStats-GB、TopicEmitterTrace-SGD和TopicEmitterHashMLP的宏平均F1分别降至0.794、0.743和0.766，而严格的未……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了ETH-TraceBench——一个覆盖13.5亿笔交易、50.1亿条日志的大规模以太坊DeFi事件流基准，通过时间、协议、基础设施和符号四类偏移划分评估模型泛化能力，并揭示简单模型在时间测试上表现优异但在协议新颖性下性能大幅下降。
en_tdlr: ETH-TraceBench is a large-scale Ethereum DeFi event-stream benchmark with 1.35 billion transactions and 5.01 billion log rows, designed to evaluate model representations under temporal, protocol, infrastructure, and symbolic shift, revealing that simple models achieve strong temporal-test performance but degrade sharply under protocol novelty.
